question_text:
Implement a secure cryptographic or defensive utility for **Challenge #16: Web Application Security & OWASP Top 10**.

### Problem Specification:
- Write an algorithm in Python that enforces safe token hashing, secure session generation, or constant-time comparison.
- Defend against timing attacks (use `hmac.compare_digest`).
- Avoid deprecated algorithms (MD5, SHA1, DES, ECB mode).
answer_explanation: Evaluates secure HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and constant-time comparison resisting side-channel timing attacks in Web Application Security & OWASP Top 10.

criteria.name: Functional Correctness
criteria.description: Passes all visible and hidden unit test cases without errors.

criteria.description: Idiomatic naming, handling edge boundaries and null guards.
